svg.text: Altered after reading weaviate/elysia-frontend and Odysseus source: typed displays, graph evidence, dockable tools, command palette, MCP/skills governance, UI events, background jobs, and persistent local operator state.

g.text: Elysia pattern: one chat surface that can switch into Tree, Display, Code, and Settings views.
Query routes can be exposed for development, but normal operators stay in natural language.
Compare Elysia frontend patterns with Aura Phase 9.
user message, collapsed after first response
Reading frontend source, grouping payload types, checking tree view.
status line mirrors Elysia currentStatus in QueryInput
Tabs appear when adjacent result payloads share display type but different source collections.
document, table, aggregation, chart, conversation, ticket, code.
Aura mapping: web_result, local_artifact, graph_chunk, swarm_report, mcp_message.
The final response uses inline numbered citation bubbles.
Elysia uses React Flow + dagre; Aura adapts it as a compact agent decision trace.
Use typed displays because raw tool cards are too narrow for evidence review.
Preserve source provenance and no public fallback.
Adapted from Elysia Data Explorer: table, metadata, and configuration views for Aura sources.
Warning: this source set has unprocessed local files. Search quality may be limited until metadata is mapped.
Elysia has explicit warning, rate-limit, suggestion, and self-healing error displays.
Aura retries with safer args and shows the recovered path.
SearXNG returned sparse results; local sources are weighted higher.
SSRF guard blocked metadata/internal address. Safe reason only.
Ask: "show only conflicting local files" or "open the worker transcript".
Feedback controls live under completed answers: copy, heart, thumbs up, thumbs down, duration.
Mode switch plus display drawer, no desktop side rails.
1. Mode switch: Chat, Tree, Displays/Code, Settings.
2. Result payload router with typed display components.
3. Merged result tabs for multiple source collections.
5. React Flow-like tree with selected path and details drawer.
6. Source explorer with table, metadata, and configuration views.
7. Citation bubbles, feedback controls, explicit system events.
1. No Weaviate collection copy: Aura sources are Online, D:\tmp, Graph, MCP, and artifacts.
2. Swarm remains minimal: visible worker reports, not sibling chat.
3. SSRF, local-only, SearXNG, and sidecar spillover are first-class states.
4. Dark ops palette is adopted, but layout stays denser and less decorative.
Design the frontend around event payload types, not around screenshots. A payload can render as chat, display, code, raw data, source details, or tree node metadata.
Missing piece added: Neo4j is a real visualization mode with Cypher context, path evidence, schema filters, and selected-node inspection.
Find claims that contradict local Phase 9 notes...
NL query compiles to inspected Cypher before execution.
Graph is evidence-bearing: layout, color, size, and edge labels all encode retrieved Neo4j data.
09-CONTEXT.md -> Claim: Graph mode missing -> Aura Deep Search -> Agent swarm-4 -> Elysia source
Applied after studying pewdiepie-archdaemon/odysseus: adaptive rail, dockable tool windows, command palette, AI ui_control events, persistent theme/density, and background job feedback.
Odysseus pattern: full sidebar can collapse to a narrow rail with active/minimized dots.
Apply to Aura: rail stays available when tool windows dock or graph mode is full screen.
Odysseus pattern: Ctrl+K global search and slash commands for app actions.
Open Graph mode with selected path
Apply to Aura: commands are shortcuts to visible tools, not hidden magic.
Odysseus pattern: tool modals can minimize, restore, dock left/right, tile, and preserve state.
Source gathering continues while the user edits the answer.
Blind or named comparison, parallel streams, vote/synthesis.
Odysseus pattern: backend events can update visible UI controls safely.
Apply to Aura: UI events are audited, allowlisted, and replayable from the run log.
Never let model output arbitrary selectors or unsafe actions.
Odysseus pattern: localStorage theme paints before app boot to avoid flash.
sidebar side, dock positions, collapsed sections, last graph view, reduced motion.
Aura-local governance surface: managed MCP servers, allowlisted tools, doctor checks, skills install provenance, pending activation, approval gates, and audit trail.
CLI parity for install, add, list, enable, disable, remove.
Env editor never displays secrets raw. AURA_MCP_SERVERS_JSON override is visible.
Operational checks make MCP mounting explainable before the agent sees tools.
Dead server produces a warning, not a boot failure.
Tools view shows exactly what was mounted into the live registry.
Skill install is treated as supply-chain input, not a casual marketplace click.
owner/repo, skills.sh slug, or package accepted by skills CLI
Size cap, injection literal blocklist, sanitized name, path guard.
The operator can inspect active, pending, archived, and rejected skill states.
One queue for MCP config changes, skill mutations, and other risky actions.
Show command, source, hash, files touched, risk tier, and resume token.
Never activate installed skills directly from a model tool call.
Pending items can be approved by ask_user or explicit CLI.
